descriptions.mx16sa_camera_event_800d9de4: Dispatches a camera event when name +304 is nonempty, handle +20 resolves and elapsed +380 is positive. Queries the named entry, obtains its descriptor through slot +20 and walks parent links +20 until the requested descriptor or a self-linked root. For type 0x80367b08, reads Camera.Track.MinEventTime, tests visibility of the position vector +276, and calls 0x800edc28 when the position is not visible or unsigned elapsed exceeds the minimum. Otherwise type 0x80367b58 calls 0x800edca0. External object and descriptor ownership remains pending.
